description: One renewal of one certificate: the expiration date it moved from, the date it moved to, when that happened and who did it. A child table rather than its own doctype because a renewal has no existence apart from the certificate it renews — unlike a Note Payable Event, which records money moving and has to survive its note being closed.

fields.description: The date the renewal was recorded here — not necessarily the date the issuing body signed it, which belongs in the notes if the two differ and it matters.
fields.label: Renewed On

fields.description: What the certificate expired on before this renewal. Kept so a lapse is visible: a renewal recorded after the previous expiration date is a period the operation was uncertified, and that gap does not disappear because somebody renewed late.
fields.label: Previous Expiration

fields.description: The new certificate number, where a renewal issues one. Blank means it kept the old number.
fields.label: New Certificate Number

fields.description: What was done to renew it — the audit that was passed, the fee that was paid, the training that was completed. The part nobody can reconstruct from the dates.
fields.label: What Was Done

name: Certification Renewal
